job: Preview a link's target, such as a person or a provider, without leaving the page.
purpose: A card that opens after half a second of hovering a link, stays open while the pointer travels into it, and closes a quarter second after leaving. It holds a title, meta, a line of text and a few stats. It is not for actions or forms.
useWhen: A name in a table or sentence links to a person, provider or run and a quick look saves a click.
Preview facts are read-only: a role, counts, a date.

avoidWhen.when: The content has actions, inputs or links people must click.
Naming an icon button or a shortcut.
The preview is needed on touch devices.

states.name: open
states.how: data-state="open"; opens 500ms after hover, set by data-open-delay

states.name: closing
states.how: data-state="closing" for a quarter second after leaving

parts.role: A muted line, such as an email and role.

keyboard.does: Focusing the link opens the card.
